quote_original: Then I realized that my body was dead.
context_before: Although I knew of no road that would lead me back, I knew that feeling was the secret. So, while standing in a solidly real body, I imagined my head was on a pillow. I persisted until I knew I was there.
context_after: That I was a living presence which had moved into it. It seemed like an eternity before I could move my little finger, my arm from the elbow down, and finally to feel the warmth of my wife’s body and know I had returned.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 11-4-1968 (1968-11-04).

author: Neville Goddard

context_before: Every moment of the day you are thinking. Be careful what you think, for your thoughts will be tested by fire, and if they survive you will receive a reward.
context_after: But if you believe fulfillment is conditioned on a chain letter, another person, or going to church and praying to an unknown God, then something has come between you and the one foundation. Nothing must come between you and your imagination (thought), who is the Lord Jesus Christ.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 11-4-1968 (1968-11-04).

author: Neville Goddard

quote_original: Make imagination your one solid foundation.
context_after: Do this and you will enjoy a freedom you have not known before. It is a fantastic freedom! Just imagine and it’s done!
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 11-4-1968 (1968-11-04).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-11-04 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: How can anyone interpret that which is unreal?
context_before: I tell you the world you step into tonight when you put your head on a pillow is just as real as this one. Men claim it is a shadow and unreal, yet from these so-called dreams they interpret their state of consciousness.
context_after: The reality of that world as opposed to this one is solely produced from the level upon which consciousness is focused. If you are thinking from that world it seems the only reality. Focus your attention on this level, however, and that world will seem unreal. So, objectivity and subjectivity are solely determined by the level of consciousness upon which the individual is focused.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 11-4-1968 (1968-11-04).
